summary.text: Sean Steele is an independent candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 65 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Christopher May. He is a public school teacher who says he has taught in the district for 31 years.

paragraphs.text: Sean Steele graduated from Bedford North Lawrence High School, earned a bachelor's degree from DePauw University in 1990 and a law degree from the Indiana University Maurer School of Law in 1994.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived most of his life in Lawrence County and has been married for 27 years, with two grown children.
He said he currently teaches art at Bedford Middle School and previously taught social studies at Orleans Jr./Sr. High School for 22 years, and that he has coached for most of his teaching career.
Steele said he is running because he believes politicians serve parties and large donors rather than voters.
He listed affordability, access to affordable healthcare, full funding for public education and a more restrictive approach to data centers as priorities.
